description: Neutral policy, verification, and mediation gateway for ads inside AI chat and agents. See CLAUDE.md, docs/api.md, docs/policy.md, docs/audit.md, docs/BUILD_GUIDE.md.
rules: One story per iteration. Lowest priority number first, dependencies must all pass.
Tests first. All acceptance criteria are required, none are optional.
Never change the meaning of docs/api.md, docs/policy.md, docs/audit.md.
Fail closed. Postgres only. Ads never inside model output. Paid users never see ads by default.

stories.title: Monorepo scaffold
stories.description: pnpm workspaces + Turborepo, TypeScript strict, ESM, shared tsconfig.base.json, Vitest at root with per-package projects, ESLint + Prettier minimal config. Packages: schemas, core, gateway, sdk, each with src/index.ts and one passing smoke test.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm install, pnpm test, pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint all succeed from a clean clone
Root scripts exist: dev, test, typecheck, lint, db:migrate (db:migrate may be a placeholder that prints a message until S16)
Each of packages/schemas, packages/core, packages/gateway, packages/sdk has package.json, tsconfig.json, src/index.ts, and one *.test.ts that passes
turbo.json defines pipelines for build, test, typecheck, lint
.gitignore covers node_modules, dist, .env, .ralph/logs/*.log, coverage

stories.title: Local infra, CI, license, README
stories.description: docker-compose.yml with Postgres 16 (healthcheck, volume, POSTGRES_DB adgate and adgate_test created via init script), .env.example, GitHub Actions workflow running install, typecheck, lint, test with a Postgres service, Apache 2.0 LICENSE text, README describing what adgate is and is not.
acceptanceCriteria: docker compose up -d postgres starts a healthy Postgres with databases adgate and adgate_test

.env.example lists every env var the gateway will need with comments (DATABASE_URL, DATABASE_URL_TEST, ADGATE_SIGNING_KEY_PEM, ADGATE_SIGNING_KEY_ID, CLASSIFIER_BASE_URL, CLASSIFIER_API_KEY, CLASSIFIER_MODEL, ADMIN_PASSWORD, PORT)
.github/workflows/ci.yml runs on push and PR and passes on this commit
LICENSE contains the full Apache License 2.0 text
README.md has sections: What adgate is, What it is not, Quickstart (placeholder steps allowed until S39), Repo layout

stories.title: Zod schemas for the API contract
stories.description: In packages/schemas: EvaluateRequest, EvaluateResponse, Classification, Creative, SuppressReason, AttestRequest, EventRequest, VerifyResponse exactly as in docs/api.md. Export TS types via z.infer and a toJsonSchema() helper that emits JSON Schema for every schema (for the Python SDK).
acceptanceCriteria: Every JSON example in docs/api.md parses successfully with the matching schema
SuppressReason accepts only the listed reasons; sensitive_category:<name> is validated against the sensitive taxonomy in fixtures/classify-fixtures.json
EvaluateRequest rejects when both messages and context_summary are absent
toJsonSchema() writes packages/schemas/json/*.schema.json and a test asserts they are up to date
No hand-written TS types duplicate a schema

stories.title: PolicyConfig schema, YAML loader, policy hash
stories.description: PolicyConfig schema with defaults from docs/policy.md, loadPolicyFromYaml(yaml) returning { policy, policy_hash }, canonical JSON helper in packages/core/src/canonical, mergeOverrides(policy, overrides) that only tightens and reports rejected keys.
acceptanceCriteria: examples/policy.example.yaml loads and equals the defaulted policy
Unknown keys rejected; self_harm cannot be removed from blocked_categories; non-free tiers without allow_paid_tiers rejected
policy_hash is identical for two YAML documents with different key order and whitespace
mergeOverrides ignores loosening changes and returns them in rejected[]; tightening changes apply
Canonical JSON: sorted keys at every depth, no whitespace, tested against a fixture with nested objects and arrays

stories.title: Policy engine
stories.description: packages/core/src/policy/evaluatePolicy({ classification, user, policy, capState, surface }) returning { allowed, reason, decisions[] } with the exact rule order from docs/policy.md. Pure function, no I/O.
acceptanceCriteria: Rules run in documented order; first failure sets reason; every rule still appends a decision entry
Tests: paid user suppressed; region blocked; health suppressed even with intent 0.95; low confidence; low intent; each frequency cap at boundary (equal to cap is allowed only if strictly below)
competitor_exclusions recorded as pending
policy package has zero imports from gateway or any I/O library

stories.title: Rules classifier
stories.description: packages/core/src/classify/rules: keyword and regex lists per sensitive category and per commercial category family from fixtures/classify-fixtures.json taxonomy. Returns a preliminary Classification with method rules. self_harm always sensitive.
acceptanceCriteria: Every sensitive case in fixtures/classify-fixtures.json is flagged with the expected category by rules alone (zero false negatives)
No low-intent case (ids starting with l) is flagged sensitive
Keyword lists live in data files, one per category, easy to extend
Normalization handles case, punctuation, and common typos listed in a small alias file

stories.title: LLM classifier with timeout and versioned prompt
stories.description: LlmClassifier interface; OpenAiCompatibleClassifier calling a chat completions endpoint with strict JSON output, 400 ms timeout via AbortController, base URL, key, and model from injected config (not process.env in core). Prompt in one file with a sha256 prompt_version. FakeLlmClassifier for tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Timeout returns { ok: false, reason: timeout } without throwing
Malformed JSON from the model returns { ok: false, reason: parse }
prompt_version changes when the prompt file changes (test computes it)
No network calls in tests; fake used everywhere

stories.title: classify() orchestrator with cache and merge
stories.description: classify(messages, deps) runs rules; if a sensitive category matched with high confidence, return immediately. Otherwise LLM, then merge (LLM wins on categories and intent, sensitive is the union, confidence = LLM confidence unless rules fired then min). In-memory LRU keyed by sha256(normalized text + prompt_version), 10 minute TTL, 50k max. Falls back to rules-only on LLM failure.
acceptanceCriteria: Full fixture test: sensitive precision 100 percent, serve cases within intent bounds and categories_any satisfied, low cases under intent_max, using the fake LLM seeded from the fixtures
Cache hit returns method cached and skips the LLM
LLM failure path returns method rules with confidence from rules
classify never throws; a thrown error inside is converted to a rules-only result

stories.title: DemandAdapter interface and DirectAdapter
stories.description: packages/core/src/demand: DemandAdapter, DemandRequest, DemandResponse, Candidate types. DirectAdapter takes an in-memory creative catalog and matches by category overlap (supports trailing wildcard like software.devtools.*) and keyword overlap; returns top 3 with ecpm_estimate and targeting_match in [0,1].
acceptanceCriteria: examples/creatives.seed.json loads into DirectAdapter and the c001 fixture text yields the database creative first
Region filtering respects target_regions and the EU token
Inactive creatives never returned
Deterministic ordering on ties (by creative id)

stories.title: AffiliateAdapter link builders
stories.description: Template based builders for partnerstack, impact, and amazon (Associates tag). Catalog entries carry url_template with {{program_id}} and {{tag}} placeholders filled from app-level affiliate config supplied by the caller. No network calls.
acceptanceCriteria: Each network builds a correctly encoded URL from a template and config, tested
Missing affiliate config for a network yields zero candidates and a trace error, never a throw
Code comments state clearly that the app owner brings their own affiliate accounts

stories.title: mediate() across adapters
stories.description: mediate(adapters, req, policy, { timeoutMs }) runs enabled adapters in parallel with Promise.allSettled and per-adapter timeout, filters competitor_exclusions by advertiser_domain, ranks by ecpm_estimate * targeting_match, returns { selected, trace } matching the demand block in docs/audit.md.
acceptanceCriteria: A slow adapter does not delay a fast one beyond the timeout (fake timers)
Excluded advertisers appear in trace.excluded and are never selected
All adapters failing returns selected null and no throw
trace.responses has one entry per requested adapter with latency_ms

stories.title: Koah and Gravity adapter stubs
stories.description: KoahAdapter and GravityAdapter implement DemandAdapter, accept config objects, and return a trace error NotConfigured unless enabled with credentials. Leave a documented TODO describing the expected request shape and a link placeholder for partner docs.
acceptanceCriteria: Both adapters compile, are exported, and return { candidates: [], error: 'not_configured' } when disabled
mediate() with a disabled stub still returns results from other adapters
docs/decisions.md item 10 is referenced in the file header

stories.title: Hashing and Ed25519 signing utilities
stories.description: packages/core/src/audit/crypto: sha256Hex(string), generateKeypair() returning PEM strings and a key_id, sign(hashHex, privatePem) returning ed25519:base64, verifySignature(hashHex, signature, publicPem). Uses node:crypto only.
acceptanceCriteria: Round trip sign/verify passes; tampered hash fails
Signature format is exactly 'ed25519:' followed by base64
Works with keys loaded from PEM strings (as they will come from env)

stories.title: buildAuditRecord and hash chain
stories.description: buildAuditRecord(input) assembles an AuditRecord per docs/audit.md from classification, policy result, mediation trace, selected creative, disclosure, app metadata, prev_hash. Computes record_hash over canonical JSON without record_hash and signature, plus prev_hash; signs it.
acceptanceCriteria: The example in docs/audit.md validates against the AuditRecord schema
conversation_id_hash = sha256(salt + conversation_id) and raw ids never appear in the record
Suppress decisions produce a record with creative null and demand.requested empty
Two records built in sequence chain correctly (second.prev_hash equals first.record_hash); first uses 'genesis'

stories.title: attest() and verify()
stories.description: attest(record, model_output_hash, now) returns a new signed record with separation_attestation true and supersedes_hash set. verify(record, publicKeys, { prevRecord, storedCreativeHash, supersededRecord }) returns { valid, checks[] } in the documented order.
acceptanceCriteria: Tampering with any of: classification, creative.content_hash, disclosure.label, prev_hash, signature causes the correctly named check to fail
Rotation scenario with two key ids verifies both old and new records
Attested record verifies and its superseded record still verifies
verify never throws on malformed input; schema check fails instead

stories.title: Gateway skeleton, config, Drizzle schema, migrations
stories.description: Hono app in packages/gateway with a Zod validated config module reading env, pino logger with request ids, GET /healthz, Drizzle schema for apps, api_keys, advertisers, creatives, audit_records, events, cap_state, classify_cache, raw_text (only used when store_raw_text), and drizzle-kit migrations. pnpm db:migrate runs them.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm db:migrate creates all tables on the docker Postgres
Indexes: audit_records(app_id, ts), events(audit_id), cap_state primary key (app_id, conversation_hash), classify_cache(expires_at)
GET /healthz returns { ok: true } in an integration test against the test database
Config validation fails fast with a readable error when an env var is missing

stories.title: API keys, auth middleware, app and creative seeding
stories.description: argon2 hashed API keys with roles app and advertiser_read, constant time compare, bearer auth middleware that attaches app context, and scripts: create-app (prints the key once), seed-creatives (loads examples/creatives.seed.json).
acceptanceCriteria: Requests without a valid key get 401 with the documented error body
Revoked keys are rejected
advertiser_read keys cannot call evaluate (403)
Seed script is idempotent

stories.title: POST /v1/evaluate end to end
stories.description: Wire policy load + validated overrides, cap_state read, classify with Postgres cache in front of the LRU, evaluatePolicy, mediate with DirectAdapter (creatives from DB) and AffiliateAdapter, buildAuditRecord chained to the app's last record, persist, cap_state upsert, respond. Whole handler wrapped so any error returns HTTP 200 with decision suppress and reason error, logged with request id. Messages truncated to last 4 and 4,000 chars before classification.
acceptanceCriteria: Integration tests: serve path returns a creative and audit_id; paid user, sensitive, low intent, frequency cap, no_fill, and region paths each return the exact documented reason
A simulated DB failure during audit persistence returns decision suppress reason error with status 200
Overrides that loosen policy are ignored and appear in the audit record as override_rejected
Second call in the same conversation is suppressed by frequency_cap per_session 1
Raw message text is not present in any table unless store_raw_text is true (test queries the DB)

stories.title: Attest, events, click redirect
stories.description: POST /v1/attest, POST /v1/events (duplicate impressions ignored), GET /c/:audit_id logging a click and redirecting to the resolved destination (affiliate placeholders filled at this point).
acceptanceCriteria: Attest creates a new audit record that verifies and supersedes the original
Second impression event for the same audit_id is a no-op
Click redirect returns 302 with the correct Location and writes a click event; unknown audit id returns 404
Events for an audit_id belonging to another app are rejected with 403

stories.title: Audit read and verify endpoints
stories.description: GET /v1/audit/:id and GET /v1/verify/:id with app and advertiser_read authorization. verify loads prev record, stored creative hash, and superseded record as needed.
acceptanceCriteria: A record tampered directly via SQL fails verify with the right check name
advertiser_read key can verify only records referencing its creatives
verify on a suppress record passes with separation_attested reported as not applicable

stories.title: Rate limiting, OpenAPI, load script
stories.description: Token bucket per API key stored in Postgres behind a RateLimiter interface; 429 with Retry-After. /openapi.json generated from the Zod schemas. packages/gateway/scripts/load.ts drives evaluate with examples/evaluate.json and prints p50/p95.
acceptanceCriteria: Rate limit trips in an integration test and resets after the window
openapi.json validates with an OpenAPI validator in a test
Load script runs against the local gateway and prints latency percentiles; docs/performance.md records the numbers from one run

stories.title: @adgate/sdk core client
stories.description: createClient({ apiKey, baseUrl, timeoutMs }) with evaluate (never rejects; resolves to suppress with reason error on any failure), attest(auditId, modelOutputText) hashing locally with SubtleCrypto or node:crypto, track(auditId, type). tsup build to ESM and CJS with types. Works in Node 20 and browsers.
acceptanceCriteria: Network error, timeout, and non-JSON response all resolve to a suppress decision
attest sends only the sha256 hash, tested by inspecting the request body
Build outputs dist/index.js, dist/index.cjs, dist/index.d.ts and the core entry is under 15 kB gzipped (test asserts size)

stories.title: withGeneration and forStream helpers
stories.description: withGeneration(req, generate) runs evaluate in parallel with the caller's generate() and attests with the final text, returning { answer, decision }. forStream(req) returns { decisionPromise, onChunk, finish } accumulating a hash and attesting on finish.
acceptanceCriteria: Both helpers call attest exactly once with the correct hash of the full text
If evaluate fails, the answer is still returned and decision is suppress
If generate throws, the error propagates and no attest is sent

stories.title: React SponsoredSlot component
stories.description: @adgate/sdk/react exports SponsoredSlot({ decision, client, onDismiss }). Renders nothing on suppress. On serve: separate block, label from disclosure_label, headline, body, CTA link with rel sponsored noopener, aria-label Sponsored content, dismiss button firing a dismiss event, impression event once on viewport entry (IntersectionObserver, SSR safe). Refuses to render inside an ancestor with data-adgate-message=assistant and logs a warning.
acceptanceCriteria: Testing Library tests for suppress, serve, dismiss, single impression, and the separation guard
No inline styles beyond a minimal default; accepts className
Component has no dependency on Next.js

stories.title: Vercel AI SDK middleware
stories.description: @adgate/sdk/ai exports adgateMiddleware(client, { getUser, appId }) usable with wrapLanguageModel: runs evaluate on the latest user message in parallel with generation, attaches the decision to providerMetadata, attests with the final text (streaming and non streaming).
acceptanceCriteria: Works with a fake language model in tests for both generate and stream paths
Decision is available to the caller without changing the model output text
Middleware never throws even when evaluate fails

stories.title: Python SDK
stories.description: packages/sdk-python: package adgate (pyproject, hatchling, Python 3.10+). Pydantic v2 models generated from packages/schemas/json by a script and checked in. Sync and async clients (httpx) with evaluate (never raises), attest, track, and async with_generation. pytest with respx.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated models round trip every example in docs/api.md
evaluate returns a suppress decision on connection error, timeout, and malformed JSON
pip install -e . and pytest pass in CI (add a python job)
Regeneration script fails CI if models are stale

stories.title: examples/nextjs-chat
stories.description: Minimal Next.js chat using the Vercel AI SDK against an OpenAI compatible endpoint, wired with adgateMiddleware and SponsoredSlot, a free/paid toggle to show paid suppression, and a README with 5 minute setup against the local gateway.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm --filter nextjs-chat dev runs and a devtools question shows a labeled sponsored block after the answer
Toggling paid results in no slot and the audit record shows reason paid_user
The slot is rendered outside the assistant message container

stories.title: examples/fastapi-chat
stories.description: FastAPI app streaming answers with SSE and emitting a separate 'sponsored' SSE event after the answer using the Python SDK; tiny HTML page that renders the slot below the message.
acceptanceCriteria: uvicorn runs; a devtools question yields an answer stream then one sponsored event
Sensitive question yields no sponsored event and the audit record shows the sensitive reason

stories.title: docs/integration.md
stories.description: Integration guide for three shapes: web chat UI, agent framework loop (evaluate on the user goal at task start, render the slot only in the final report), coding agent CLI (one labeled line after the final answer, never inside code blocks). Copy paste snippets for TS and Python.
acceptanceCriteria: Every snippet compiles or runs against the current SDKs (add a docs test that type checks TS snippets)
Guide states the disclosure and separation rules explicitly for each shape

stories.title: Dashboard scaffold
stories.description: packages/dashboard: Next.js App Router + Tailwind, single admin password from env with a cookie session, read only Drizzle queries module, layout with nav for apps, creatives, audit, reports.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm dev serves the dashboard on :3000 with login
Unauthenticated requests redirect to login
Playwright smoke test logs in and sees the nav

stories.title: Apps pages: list, create, policy editor
stories.description: /apps lists apps; create app generates and shows the API key once; /apps/[id]/policy edits YAML with inline validation errors from loadPolicyFromYaml and shows the policy_hash.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid YAML shows the schema error message next to the editor and does not save
Saving bumps policy_version and updates policy_hash
Key is shown exactly once and never retrievable again

stories.title: App overview metrics
stories.description: /apps/[id]: last 30 days of turns evaluated, ad eligible rate, fill rate, impressions, clicks, CTR, estimated revenue (sum of ecpm_estimate per impression / 1000), RPM per 1000 eligible turns, suppress reason breakdown, with recharts. Global /apps header shows YC metrics: apps integrated, total turns, eligible rate, RPM, advertisers with a generated report.
acceptanceCriteria: Metric calculations live in a pure module with unit tests against fixture data (hand computed expected values in the test)
Charts render with empty data without errors
Queries use indexes (EXPLAIN in a test is optional, but no full scans on audit_records without app_id and ts)

stories.title: Creatives CRUD
stories.description: /creatives: list, create, edit, deactivate direct and affiliate creatives; validation mirrors the DB schema and the Creative schema.
acceptanceCriteria: Creating a creative makes it immediately eligible for DirectAdapter (integration test through evaluate)
Deactivated creatives disappear from results without deleting audit history

stories.title: Audit search and detail with live verify
stories.description: /audit: filter by app, date range, decision, reason; detail page shows the record, the chain neighbors, and runs verify() live listing every check.
acceptanceCriteria: A tampered record (inserted via SQL in a test) is displayed as invalid with the failing check highlighted
Pagination works past 1,000 records

stories.title: Verification report generator
stories.description: /reports/new: pick advertiser and date range; generate a report with impressions and clicks by app, category distribution, sensitive exposures (must be zero), disclosure compliance percent, separation attestation percent, chain integrity result; downloadable JSON bundle of underlying records and a printable HTML view.
acceptanceCriteria: Report calculations in a pure module with unit tests against a fixture that includes at least one attested, one unattested, and one suppress record
JSON bundle re-verifies offline using packages/core verify with the public key
Generating a report increments the advertisers-with-report metric on /apps

stories.title: Security pass
stories.description: Body size limits, message truncation confirmed, CORS allowlist from env, helmet style headers, SQL parameterization review, dependency audit script, SECURITY.md with disclosure policy.
acceptanceCriteria: Requests over the body limit get 413
CORS blocks origins not in the allowlist in a test
pnpm audit --prod reports no critical vulnerabilities or documents accepted ones in SECURITY.md

stories.title: Privacy: retention job and docs
stories.description: scripts/retention.ts deletes audit records, events, and raw_text older than each app's privacy.retain_days (chain integrity note: deletion is from the oldest end only). docs/privacy.md lists every stored field and its purpose.
acceptanceCriteria: Retention test: records older than retain_days are deleted, newer ones kept, chain verify still passes for kept records when prevRecord is missing due to retention (verify reports chain as 'pruned' not failed)
A test asserts no table contains raw message text when store_raw_text is false

stories.title: Prometheus metrics
stories.description: GET /metrics with counters for decisions by reason, histograms for evaluate latency and per adapter latency, classifier cache hit ratio.
acceptanceCriteria: Metrics endpoint is protected by a separate METRICS_TOKEN env var
After one serve and one suppress in tests, counters reflect both

stories.title: Docs and quickstart

docs/api-reference.md is generated by a script and a test checks it is current

CHANGELOG.md generated by changesets exists
